D: Thor teams up with Valkyrie, Korg and a newly powerful Jane to stop the god butcher Gorr.
P: Serve the snacks when the giant screaming goats pull the longship into the sky.
S: the fishing village turned tourist town of New Asgard
Smoked trout and pickled herring on rye crispbread with crème fraîche, dill and thinly sliced red onion.
Omnipotence City feta and honey triangles
Zeus's golden city of the gods

Feta, spinach and mint wrapped in buttered filo triangles, baked golden and crackling, brushed with honey and scattered with sesame. Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 200g crumbled feta, 1 egg, chopped mint and pepper. Cut 8 filo sheets into 3 long strips each, brushing with 80g melted butter. Put a spoonful of filling at the end of each strip and fold into triangles. Brush with butter and bake at 190C for 20 minutes until golden. Brush with 2 tbsp warm honey and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Toothgnasher and Toothgrinder, the screaming goats
Soft goat's cheese rolled into balls, coated in crushed pistachios and chives, served on crackers with a little fig jam on each.
M: life in New Asgard on the Norwegian coast

Salmon, white fish and prawns poached in a creamy broth with leek, carrot and dill, served with crusty bread and butter. Soften 1 sliced leek and 2 diced carrots in 30g butter for 5 minutes. Add 2 diced potatoes and 1L fish stock and simmer 12 minutes. Stir in 300ml cream, then add 300g salmon and 300g white fish in chunks and simmer gently for 4 minutes. Add 200g peeled prawns and cook 2 minutes more. Season, stir through chopped dill and a squeeze of lemon, and serve with crusty bread.
Valkyrie ruling as king of New Asgard
Beef short ribs braised 4 hours in dark beer with onion and thyme until falling apart, over mashed potato.
W: Crisp layers of buttered filo and spiced walnuts and pistachios, baked golden and soaked in lemon honey syrup, cut into diamonds. Mix 300g chopped walnuts and pistachios with 1 tsp cinnamon. Layer 375g filo in a 20 x 30cm tin, brushing every sheet with 200g melted butter and scattering nuts every few sheets, ending with filo. Cut into diamonds and bake at 170C for 45 minutes until golden. Boil 200g sugar, 150ml water, 100g honey and a squeeze of lemon for 5 minutes and pour over the hot baklava. Cool 4 hours before serving.
K: Korg telling the story by the fire

Pineapple and passionfruit juice with spiced rum, lime and ginger beer, poured into a big jug of ice with mint and pineapple wedges. In a big jug, mix 1L pineapple juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit, 200ml spiced rum and the juice of 2 limes. Chill until ready. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and 750ml ginger beer, and stir gently. Drop in pineapple wedges and mint sprigs. For a kids' jug, leave out the rum and add more ginger beer.

s.note: the fishing village turned tourist town of New Asgard
s.how: Spread rye crispbreads with creme fraiche. Top half with flaked smoked trout and half with pieces of pickled herring. Finish each with a sprig of dill and a few thin slices of red onion. Serve on a board, Norwegian fishing village style.

s.note: Toothgnasher and Toothgrinder, the screaming goats
s.how: Roll 200g soft goat's cheese into small balls. Roll each in finely chopped pistachios mixed with snipped chives. Set each on a water cracker with a small spoon of fig jam underneath. Arrange in rows and keep any screaming goats well away.

m.note: Valkyrie ruling as king of New Asgard
m.how: Brown 2kg beef short ribs all over. Add 2 sliced onions, thyme and 375ml stout, then water to come halfway. Cover and braise at 160C for 4 hours until falling apart. Mash 1kg potatoes with plenty of butter and serve the ribs on top.
